summary: Verified (1) first-login forced password change gate for istasyon_sorumlusu and (2) frontend regression after backend router refactor. All force-password flows PASSED end-to-end. All 6 pages (Dashboard/Personeller/İzinler/Nöbet/İstatistikler/Ayarlar) load without errors after selecting a station as admin. Manager scope enforced (no station selector, badge visible). Add personnel works. Backend exports (Excel/PDF) return 200 via curl with correct auth. However, UI Excel/PDF export BUTTONS are broken because Schedule.jsx uses window.open() which does not send the Authorization Bearer token, so a new tab opens with 401 {"detail":"Giriş gerekli"}. This is likely pre-existing (not caused by refactor) but violates the review's requirement that exports 'trigger a download (HTTP 200, no error toast)'.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses window.open(url) which does NOT include the Authorization header — the export endpoints require Bearer JWT, so the new tab shows 401 'Giriş gerekli' instead of a file download. Must be replaced with an authenticated fetch → blob → object URL / download link (or the backend must accept a signed short-lived query token).

action_items: Fix Excel/PDF export in /app/frontend/src/pages/Schedule.jsx: replace window.open with an axios GET (responseType:'blob') using the api instance so the Authorization + X-Istasyon-Id headers are sent, then create an object URL and trigger a temporary <a download> click. Also required for admin because X-Istasyon-Id is not attached to window.open() either.
critical_code_review_comments: Schedule.jsx lines 125-126: window.open(...) for /api/schedule/{yil}/{ay}/export/excel|pdf bypasses the axios auth interceptor — this pattern is fundamentally broken for JWT-based auth and misses X-Istasyon-Id header for admins.
Refactor into routers/ + deps.py + helpers.py looks clean; deps.current_station centralizes station isolation. No behavioural regressions detected on any UI page.
Force-password gate in App.js correctly renders ForcePassword when role==istasyon_sorumlusu && !sifre_degistirildi and blocks sidebar/layout as expected.

success_rate.backend: 100% (curl e2e: login, station select, seed, personnel CRUD, generate, excel 200, pdf 200)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (force-password flow 100%, refactor regression 100%, but UI export buttons broken due to auth-less window.open)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Force-password flow (data-testid=force-password-page/force-old-password/force-new-password/force-new-password-repeat/force-submit/force-error) fully verified. Auth store (auth.jsx) correctly updates user.sifre_degistirildi on change. Only remaining fix: authenticate Excel/PDF export button (Schedule.jsx exportExcel/exportPdf). All routers respond OK: /api/schedule/generate (POST body {yil,ay,max_gun_asiri,rastgele_yoksay,ignore_leave_ids}), /api/schedule/{y}/{m}/export/excel & /pdf. Station header is X-Istasyon-Id (not X-Station-Id).
rca of the issue: Export buttons call window.open(`${api.defaults.baseURL}/schedule/${yil}/${ay}/export/{excel|pdf}`, '_blank'). A cross-tab navigation initiated by window.open sends only cookies; it does not carry axios' Authorization header, so the FastAPI dependency get_current_user rejects with 401 'Giriş gerekli'. Reproduction: log in as admin, select station 'merkez 1' (must have >=3 active personnel & a generated schedule), open /nobet, click Excel or PDF → new tab shows 401 JSON. Mitigation: fetch the file via authenticated axios (responseType='blob'), then const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=`nobet_${yil}_${ay}.xlsx`; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url).
